item.title: [IGNITE-1205] Unable to clear caches through Visor
item.description:

1) start remote node with example-ignite.xml
2) execute CacheJdbcStoreExample in Idea
3) start visorcmd with '-v' option
4) 'open' connect with example-ignite.xml
5) execute 'cache -clear'

item.summary: Unable to clear caches through Visor

status.description: The issue is considered finished, the resolution is correct. Issues which are not closed can be reopened.

comments.comment:
• Ignored discovery data exchange on daemon nodes.
  • Fixed VisorCacheClearTask serialization.
Also noticed that node still joins if discovery exchange data can be unmarshalled. This looks like a bug, created a separate ticket: https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/IGNITE-1238

Github user asfgit closed the pull request at:

https://github.com/apache/ignite/pull/17
